same_budget_comparison.scope: Every V55 query is separately charged against both frozen V53 implementations at the identical original budget. All narrower, wider, tied and unresolved cases remain.

budget_comparison.scope: Separate original b2/b10 queries; no monotonic-width assumption.

observed_v51_action_gaps.scope: For an actually observed V51 choice a at this exact public state: Q*(h,a)-V*(h), permitting optimal continuation after a with future remote messages frozen. This is neither the V51 full policy value nor realized whole-journey regret. No choices are imputed at unvisited counterfactual histories.

joint_attribution.scope: Five paid queries per state and budget, with summed process CPU. Tightened intervals and explicit equalities are derived without another solve. Original single-query aggregates and plots remain unchanged.

matched_action_attribution.scope: Supplemental matching of same forced cheap-P0/one-step arms within each version and budget; all five query costs charged. No cross-version pooling.

optimal_certificate_root_choice_alignmen.scope: Agreement at the current root action only. Fixed cheap-P0/W full-continuation policy gaps remain the separately computed intervals.

gap_scope: Conditional-state bounds, not whole-journey regret. Means across selected states have no optimal occupancy interpretation. W-P0 is signed; zero uses the reported numerical tolerance.
